target.location: Lower center-right, immediately left of the divider beside the far-right dark headphones
target.evidence: The deep teal earcup faces the viewer and connects to the beige headband of the third pair from the left.

effect.location: Outer shell, cushion, and upper rim of the selected earcup
effect.evidence: The shell and visible cushion are deep teal. The raised control and silver connector remain distinct and intact.

neighbors.location: Across the four cubbies and the surrounding shelves
neighbors.evidence: The selected pair’s headband and viewer-left earcup remain beige. The three neighboring pairs, wood grain, books and visible spine lettering, and directional lighting are preserved.

marks.location: Entire frame, including the lower-left instruction area and the area around the edited earcup
marks.evidence: The shelf and headphones are clear of red lettering, circle fragments, and stray annotation strokes.

quality.location: Edited earcup perimeter and its boundaries with the beige earcup and wooden divider
quality.evidence: The teal follows the shell and cushion contours with crisp edges. The shell retains a natural highlight and shadow gradient, the cushion weave is visible, and the wood and adjacent earcup are free of teal spill.
